page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: How Toskar should behave on this computer.
page.adminsOnly: The other settings change Toskar for everyone, so they're for Admins and the Owner.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light, dark, or follow the system.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of menus, buttons, and messages in Toskar on every computer and phone you use with it. Each device can follow its own system language.

status.machine: Machine translated, so some wording may read oddly until a person reviews it.
status.partial: Partly translated. What isn’t translated yet shows in English.

language.assistantAuto: Auto-detect: the language you write in
language.assistantHint: The language answers are written in. You can always ask for another in a message, such as “answer in English”.
language.saveFailed: The language could not be saved: {{error}}

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.description: How answers should look, in every chat and automation. This shapes style only. What the AI may do is set under Tool permissions, and nothing here or in Memory can change it.
personalization.aboutYouPlaceholder: I'm a backend engineer in Juneau. My main project is a Go service.
personalization.locationHint: Used only for questions about nearby places, weather, and directions. Leave it empty to name a place each time.
personalization.instructions: Anything else about how to answer
personalization.instructionsPlaceholder: Show code examples in Go. Mention sources at the end.

context.title: What Toskar knows about where and when you are
context.deviceOn: On, for questions that need it
context.kept: Each is used only for questions that need it. This device's location goes with each message to your own computer and isn't kept.
context.deviceHint: For nearby places, weather, and directions, start from where this device is now. Your browser asks first.
context.deviceDenied: Your browser didn't allow it. Allow location for this page in your browser's settings, then try again.
context.deviceFailed: This device couldn't say where it is. Try again in a moment.
context.deviceUsing: Using where this device is, within about {{meters}} m.
context.deviceUnavailable: This browser can't say where it is. Type your location above instead.

background.title: Keep running in background
background.description: Closing the window keeps Chat, the API, and your schedules running. Toskar turns this on when you save your first schedule; after that, it stays as you set it.
background.schedulesNeedIt: Scheduled automations don't run while Toskar is closed. Turn this on so they run on time.

launchAtLogin.title: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.description: Start Toskar automatically when you sign in to this computer.

defaultProfile.title: Default profile
defaultProfile.description: Used when you start a new chat.

runOn.title: Run chats on
runOn.description: Where work should run by default across your team.

lifecycle.title: Model lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Automatic keeps models warm after chat. Manual leaves Start and Stop to you.
lifecycle.keepReadyHint: How long a model stays loaded after its last answer, so the next question starts at once. A model a phone, tablet, watch, or TV used stays loaded for at least an hour.

downloads.title: Download models
downloads.description: When a profile needs a model that isn’t installed yet.

advanced.title: Advanced mode
advanced.description: Show model IDs, API details, logs, and other power-user controls.

discovery.title: Find other computers
discovery.description: Advertise this computer and look for other Toskar installs on your network.
discovery.needsRestart: Networking was updated. Restart Toskar so other computers can fully reach this one.
discovery.restartManually: Quit Toskar completely, then open it again to finish applying network settings.

api.title: API access
api.description: How apps and other devices can talk to Toskar.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Alerts for long-running work and team connectivity.
notifications.peerOffline: Notify when a paired computer goes offline
notifications.newerModels: Notify when a newer version of an installed model is out
notifications.newerModelsHint: Once per new generation, for Admins. Nothing is installed or switched until you choose.
notifications.digestHint: One summary of every automation’s results each day, in a chat you can reply to.

toolPermissions.title: Tool permissions
toolPermissions.description: Limits for every profile on this computer: a profile can be stricter, never looser. Git push always asks.

history.title: History
history.description: Control what Toskar keeps on this computer.
history.confirmAll_one: Delete your {{count}} chat on this computer?
history.confirmAll_other: Delete all {{count}} of your chats on this computer?
history.confirmOlder_one: Delete {{count}} chat last used more than {{days}} days ago?
history.confirmOlder_other: Delete {{count}} chats last used more than {{days}} days ago?
history.confirmDetail: Their messages, attachments, and generated files are removed. This can't be undone.
history.compactAtHint: Long chats send older messages as a summary once they fill this much of the model's window.
history.suggestModelsHint: After an answer, offer a model this computer can run that would answer that kind of question better. Only for you.

ratings.title: Community ratings
ratings.description: Rate models with 1 to 5 stars. Your ratings stay on this computer unless you choose to share one when you rate it.
ratings.showHint: Models show how people with similar computers rate them. A public summary is downloaded once a day while you browse models; it sends nothing about you.
ratings.askHint: After you’ve used a model for a while, a chat asks how it’s working.
ratings.qualityHint: When you open Models › Results, the public quality results are read from GitHub, at most once an hour. Nothing about you is sent.
ratings.moved: Community ratings, quality results, and the ask to rate models are set on the Models page.

points.stored: Your chats, memories, knowledge, files, and specialized AIs are stored on this computer, in Toskar's data folder. There's no Toskar account or cloud, and no usage data is sent to anyone.
points.leaves: Something leaves this computer only when you use a feature that goes online, such as a web search, a connected service, or a paired computer. Each time is listed below, under What left this computer.
points.atRest: Toskar doesn't encrypt its own files, and doesn't require you to. To keep them encrypted while the computer is off or locked, turn on its disk encryption: FileVault on macOS, BitLocker on Windows, or LUKS on Linux.
points.inTransit: Websites and online services are reached over encrypted HTTPS. Traffic between your own computers is encrypted too, and other devices on your network can reach this one over HTTPS. A computer running an older Toskar shows Not encrypted in Settings › Computers.
points.atRestOn: Your disk is encrypted with {{method}}, so these files stay encrypted while the computer is off or locked.
points.atRestEncrypting: Your disk is being encrypted with {{method}}. Once it finishes, these files stay encrypted while the computer is off or locked.
points.atRestOffFileVault: Your disk isn't encrypted, so anyone who has this computer can read these files. Turn on FileVault in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
points.atRestOffBitLocker: Your disk isn't encrypted, so anyone who has this computer can read these files. Turn on Device encryption in Settings → Privacy & security, or BitLocker in Control Panel.
points.atRestOffLUKS: Your disk isn't encrypted, so anyone who has this computer can read these files. On Linux, disk encryption (LUKS) is usually chosen when installing; your distribution's guide explains how to add it.

whatLeft.title: What left this computer
whatLeft.description: Toskar works on this computer. These are the times a chat, automation, or app sent something elsewhere: web searches and pages, map lookups, model and voice downloads, paired computers, Toskar's relay, and connected services. Mark memories or knowledge “This computer only” to keep chats that use them here.
whatLeft.nothing: Nothing left this computer in the last 30 days.
whatLeft.confirmDelete: Delete run records now? This removes stored prompts and tool results from past runs, and this list. Chats are not deleted.
whatLeft.deleted: Deleted {{tasks}} run records, {{automations}} automation results, and {{entries}} entries below.
whatLeft.footnote: Run records hold prompts and tool results from past runs. Chats are kept or not by History below. Each automation keeps its latest result, which “notify when the result changes” compares against.

storage.pending: Will appear when Toskar is running
storage.limitDescription: Soft limit for downloaded models on this computer.

about.tagline: Runs AI on your own computers
about.checkUpdatesHint: Once a day, Toskar asks toskar.ai for the latest version number. Nothing else is sent.

reset.title: Reset application
reset.description: Restore defaults and restart onboarding. Clears chats, custom profiles, tasks, and API keys.
reset.warningKeep: This cannot be undone. You will go through onboarding again. Downloaded models and runtimes will be kept.
reset.warningDelete: This cannot be undone. You will go through onboarding again. Downloaded models will also be deleted.
reset.failed: Could not reset the application. Try again.

external.title: External server
external.description: An OpenAI-compatible server, such as OpenAI, vLLM, or Ollama elsewhere. Its models can be chosen for a chat; Auto never picks them.
external.keyStored: Stored; type a new one to replace it
external.privacy: Chats with these models leave this computer and are recorded in What left this computer. Offline profiles, and chats using memories or knowledge marked This computer only, never use them.

devices.title: Your devices
devices.description: Phones, tablets, and TVs connected as you. Each has its own key, and disconnecting one signs it out.
devices.none: No devices are connected as you yet.
devices.confirm: Disconnect {{name}}? It will need a new code to connect again.

reports.title: Problem reports
reports.description: Report this beside an error sends what went wrong to the Toskar team, after showing the person everything it sends.
reports.send: Let people send reports to Toskar
reports.sendHint: Off, Report this only copies the report, to give to whoever runs Toskar here.

news.title: AI news
news.description: The News page shows new open models, runtime releases, and AI labs' announcements from toskar.ai.
news.showHint: Read from toskar.ai when News is opened, at most every six hours. Nothing is sent but the request.
news.moved: AI news is turned on and off on the News page.

links.title: Links in answers
links.description: Answers link only to pages their sources gave. Toskar can also ask each linked site whether the page still opens.
links.checkHint: After an answer is written, Toskar contacts each site it links to and names the links that don't open under the answer. Each check is listed in What left this computer.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The voices Toskar reads aloud in: live voice mode, answers read aloud on your phone and in the car, and the doorbell.
voice.unavailable: Voice settings aren't available on this computer.

kitten.name: Kitten TTS 2 mini
kitten.description: Adds natural voices to choose from in {{languages}}, and reads aloud in Kitten the languages that had only a basic voice. Languages that already have a natural voice keep it unless you choose a Kitten voice below. Installs about 1.5 GB on this computer, including the voices, runs on the processor, and uses about 1 GB of memory while it speaks.

needs.chat: To answer in voice mode, Toskar needs a chat model.
needs.vision: To see who's at the door, Toskar needs a model that can see pictures.
needs.both: To answer in voice mode and see who's at the door, Toskar needs a model that chats and sees pictures. One model does both.
needs.none: None in the catalog fits this computer.

voice.noVoice: {{languages}} can't be read aloud yet: read aloud, voice mode and the doorbell don't speak it.
voice.thinkingSoundHint: In voice chat, a soft chime plays while an answer takes more than a moment, so you know Toskar heard you. Only for you.
voice.hearingHint: Accurate hears noticeably better in a noisy room or with a far microphone, such as a webcam's. It answers a few tenths of a second later, downloads about 480 MB once, and uses about 500 MB more memory. For live voice and the doorbell.
voice.languageHint: Detects the language of each turn and answers in it. Choose one language if everyone here always speaks it: Toskar hears it more reliably and doesn't mistake a short word for another language.

sections.apps: Use Toskar in other AI apps

features.intro: What each feature needs on this computer. Set up installs everything a feature still needs in one step.
features.partly: Sets up what it can from here. The rest is listed above.

needs.tools: A model that can use tools
needs.embedding: A model that searches by meaning
needs.voice: A voice to speak and listen

none.chat: No chat model in the catalog fits this computer's memory. A paired computer with more memory could run one.
none.tools: No model that can use tools fits this computer's memory. A paired computer with more memory could run one.
none.vision: No model that sees pictures fits this computer's memory. A paired computer with more memory could run one.
none.embedding: No embedding model fits this computer's memory.
none.voice: Speaking and listening can't be set up on this computer.
none.images: Pictures can't be made on this computer or a paired one.
none.video: Clips can't be made on this computer or a paired one.
none.trainer: Training needs a Mac with Apple Silicon or a computer with an NVIDIA graphics card. Pair one to train on it.
none.camera: Connect a camera, such as a Reolink camera or one in Home Assistant.

voice.title: Voice conversations
voice.what: Talk with Toskar out loud, on the computer and the phone.

door.title: Answer the door
door.what: Toskar sees who is at a camera, talks with them, and tells you.

pictures.title: Make pictures
pictures.what: Create and edit pictures from a description.

clips.title: Make clips
clips.what: Create short video clips from a description or a picture.

see.title: Understand pictures
see.what: Answer questions about pictures and screenshots you send.

meaning.title: Search knowledge by meaning
meaning.what: Find what you mean in your files, not only the words you typed.

automationTools.title: Automations that use tools
automationTools.what: Automations that search the web, read pages, or use your connected services.

train.title: Train your own AI
train.what: Teach an AI your own material, on this computer or a paired one.
